definition: Attention mechanisms that limit each token's attention computation to a subset of other tokens, rather than the full sequence, to reduce computational cost.
details: Sparse attention patterns (such as local windows or strided patterns) allow transformers to scale to much longer context lengths than standard full (quadratic-cost) self-attention would allow.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. In plain words: Attention mechanisms that limit each token's attention computation to a subset of other tokens, rather than the full sequence, to reduce computational cost. Here is how it actually plays out: Sparse attention patterns (such as local windows or strided patterns) allow transformers to scale to much longer context lengths than standard full (quadratic-cost) self-attention would allow. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Sparse Attention.
